verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is a cloud identity service, and whether its source is open is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no open-source code or license; a community post describes it as a closed-source cloud-based service. The documentation is hosted on GitHub, but that is docs content, not the product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
